answered_questions.question: Is there a website that shows Quillon outages?
answered_questions.text: Yes, if many customers are affected by an outage, updates are posted on the Quillon status page [1].

answered_questions.question: I want to keep my internet provider's router. Can the Q3 work behind it?
answered_questions.text: Yes, the Q3 can work behind your internet provider's router because you must plug the Ethernet cable from your modem into the yellow WAN port of the Q3 [4].

answered_questions.question: What should I do before giving my router to someone else?
answered_questions.text: To prepare the router for transfer, you can restore factory settings by pressing and holding the recessed reset button on the back with a paperclip for 10 seconds until the light pulses blue [2]. This will erase your Wi-Fi name, password, guest network, and parental controls. However, the documents do not state whether this is required or recommended before giving the router to someone else.

answered_questions.question: Which Wi-Fi standard does the Q3 support?
answered_questions.text: The Q3 supports WPA3 encryption by default and can be configured to use WPA2 compatibility mode for older devices [1]. The passages do not specify which Wi-Fi frequency bands (e.g., 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz) the Q3 router supports.

drafts.gap: Can I add my Quillon router to the Apple Home app?
drafts.title: Quillon router features and subscriptions
drafts.body: To transfer a Quillon Secure subscription, the customer must cancel their own subscription under Account, then Subscription. Quillon Secure subscriptions cannot be transferred to another person; the new owner must start their own subscription. Before selling or giving away a Q3 router, the buyer should open the Quillon Home app, go to Devices, select the router, and tap Remove device. After removing the device in the app, the user must perform a factory reset on the Q3 router. The Q3 does not currently support Apple HomeKit. The Q3 router works with Amazon Alexa and Google Home for voice commands.

drafts.title: Q3 IPv6 and Bridge Mode Setup
drafts.body: Bridge mode can be enabled on the Q3 behind another router. In bridge mode, parental controls, the guest network, and Quillon Secure malware blocking are not available. Port forwarding can be set up on the Q3 to allow a game server. To configure port forwarding, enter the external and internal port numbers and the protocol. The Q3 supports up to 20 port forwarding rules. No restart is needed for new port forwarding rules to take effect.

drafts.gap: Does the QC2 delete old recordings when the SD card fills up?
drafts.title: Video storage on QC2 SD cards
drafts.body: When the microSD card is full, the QC2 overwrites the oldest recordings first. The camera never stops recording even when the card is full. With continuous 1080p recording, a 128 GB card holds about 12 days of video. If motion detection recording is used instead, the card lasts much longer.
